Veterans Benefits: New Mexico exempts up to $30,000 of military retirement pay from state income tax (NMSA 7-2-5.13); the 2024 amendment removed the sunset, making the exclusion permanent. Disabled veterans rated 100% receive a full property-tax waiver on their primary residence.

Description: Alamogordo is a high-desert New Mexico city beside Holloman Air Force Base (49th Wing F-16 training and MQ-9 Reaper operations), near White Sands National Park. It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, New Mexico's $30,000 military-retirement exemption, abundant sunshine, and Walmart access. Tradeoffs include a moderate crime rate, an arid climate, and no local Costco (nearest El Paso).
